precepts.text: The armies gathered with Gog are named, Persia, Ethiopia, Libya, Gomer, and Togarmah, showing Esau conspiring to draw all the other nations to come against Israel.
precepts.point: This is the same setting as Revelation 20, when Satan is loosed in both the spiritual and the physical form: the spiritual demon Satan and the physical Esau. The Most High smites the bow out of Gog's left hand and causes his arrows to fall out of his right hand, so no weapon formed against Israel will prosper. He smacks their weapons out of their hand and their weapon is for naught.

note.label: Ezekiel 39: The Fall of Gog and the Gathering of Israel

precepts.why:
Gog is “the chief prince of Meshech and Tubal”, and Magog is the land of Russia. Whoever comes out of the land of southern Georgia and Russia we know from the scriptures is Esau. Chapter 38 sets it up: the Most High sets His face against “Gog, the land of Magog, the chief prince of Meshech and Tubal”, and says “I will turn thee back, and put hooks into thy jaws, and I will bring thee forth, and all thine army, horses and horsemen, all of them clothed with all sorts of armour, even a great company with bucklers and shields, all of them handling swords”.

Then the armies gathered with him are named: “Persia, Ethiopia, and Libya with them; all of them with shield and helmet: Gomer, and all his bands; the house of Togarmah of the north quarters, and all his bands: and many people with thee.” That is Esau conspiring to draw all the other nations to come against Israel.

This is all prophecy, going forward to the time after Christ has taken down the other nations, when Israel will be in their land. He brings Gog up from the north parts upon the mountains of Israel, leaves but the sixth part of him, and smites the bow out of his left hand and the arrows out of his right, so no weapon formed against Israel will prosper.

note.label: Bishop Nathanyel | Revelation 20

precepts.why: “After many days thou shalt be visited”: saying the same thing. “Thou shalt come into the land that is brought back from the sword, and is gathered out of many people, against the mountains of Israel”: once they are loosed they will come against the land of Israel, gathered back. “And they shall dwell safely all of them”: the Israelites there will be dwelling safely, and then these nations come against us.

note.label: Bishop Nathanyel | Revelation 20

precepts.why: “Son of man, set thy face against Gog, the land of Magog, the chief prince of Meshech and Tubal.” “Persia, Ethiopia, and Libya with them.” “And many people with thee”: when these nations are released the party isn’t over. We will be the top nation on the planet, and they will be jealous and say they have to destroy us again.

note.label: Bishop Nathanyel | Revelation 2 Message to the 7 Churches

precepts.why:
After the thousand years are expired, Satan is loosed out of prison. He goes out to deceive the nations in the four quarters of the earth, Gog and Magog, and gathers them in a number like the sand of the sea. They surround the camp of the saints and the beloved city, and fire comes down from God out of heaven to devour them.

That is the timing of Ezekiel 38. The white man is released after the thousand years, gathers the nations against the kingdom, and God destroys that assault. Applying Gog and Magog to the people currently occupying the land overlooks both the thousand years and the condition of the restored people dwelling safely.

note.label: Ashke-Nazis - Blow Up Gaza & New Jerusalem

precepts.why:
The proper precept for after many days thou shalt be visited, where they shall be loosed. “And cast him into the bottomless pit, and shut him up, and set a seal upon him, that he should deceive the nations no more, till the thousand years should be fulfilled”: “and after that he must be loosed a little season.”

Then verse seven: “And when the thousand years are expired, Satan shall be loosed out of his prison, And shall go out to deceive the nations which are in the four quarters of the earth, Gog and Magog, to gather them together to battle: the number of whom is as the sand of the sea.” Ezekiel saying after many days thou shalt be visited is Satan loosed when the thousand years are expired.

note.label: Ashke-Nazis - Blow Up Gaza & New Jerusalem

precepts.why:
Another precept about them being loosed. “And they shall be gathered together, as prisoners are gathered in the pit”: talking about the white man, the bottomless pit of Revelation 20. “And shall be shut up in the prison”: that’s that seal and that great chain.

“And after many days shall they be visited”: the same words as Ezekiel 38:8. After many days they shall be visited, meaning loosed.

note.label: Ashke-Nazis - Blow Up Gaza & New Jerusalem

precepts.why:
A precept for they shall dwell safely all of them, talking about us. “In those days shall Judah be saved, and Jerusalem shall dwell safely: and this is the name wherewith she shall be called, The Lord our righteousness.”

When we’re in the land, it says prophetically we shall dwell safely. So the bottom of Ezekiel 38:8, “and they shall dwell safely all of them”, is talking about us, not them over there today.

note.label: Ashke-Nazis - Blow Up Gaza & New Jerusalem

precepts.why:
It said unwalled villages, and I said that’s us in the Kingdom. “Behold a man with a measuring line in his hand.” “To measure Jerusalem, to see what is the breadth thereof, and what is the length thereof”: he wants to know the size.

“And, behold, the angel that talked with me went forth, and another angel went out to meet him, And said unto him, Run, speak to this young man, saying, Jerusalem shall be inhabited as towns without walls”, safely. I want you to understand that, so you know I’m not delirious; I didn’t lose my mind; I know what I’m talking about. “For the multitude of men and cattle therein”.

“For I, saith the Lord, will be unto her a wall of fire round about, and will be the glory in the midst of her.” The Lord is going to be unto us a wall of fire round about, and the glory in the midst of us. That is the land of unwalled villages Gog will go up against.

note.label: Ashke-Nazis - Blow Up Gaza & New Jerusalem

precepts.why:
Somebody saying the Bishop don’t know what he talking about, we got scripture that says we going to have walls: shut up, just be quiet. “Then verily the first covenant had also ordinances of divine service, and a worldly sanctuary. For there was a tabernacle made; the first, wherein was the candlestick, and the table, and the shewbread; which is called the sanctuary. And after the second veil, the tabernacle which is called the Holiest of all”. During the time of Moses we had the tabernacle, and inside it was the holy of holies, which only the high priest went into, with the ark of the covenant; sacrifices were done out in the center. That is how in Exodus you read about the tabernacle.

“And over it the cherubims of glory shadowing the mercyseat; of which we cannot now speak particularly.” Paul says we cannot now speak particularly because it would symbolize something: it symbolizes the Lord on his throne, with those two huge angels over the throne.

“The priests went always into the first tabernacle, accomplishing the service of God”: the priest was only allowed to go into the first tabernacle. “But into the second went the high priest alone once every year, not without blood”: we know who the high priest is today, Christ. “The Holy Ghost this signifying, that the way into the holiest of all was not yet made manifest”: it wasn’t made manifest during the time of Moses, “while as the first tabernacle was yet standing: Which was a figure for the time then present”. That word figure means a symbol, a representation, or a shadow.

In the pictures you see the tabernacle with the holy of holies, where the spirit of the Lord would come down and talk with Aaron and Moses, and Israel all around it. After Moses, Solomon built the temple, which was the tabernacle built in gold and mortar and brick; it represented the first tabernacle Moses had set up. That was burned down; we rebuilt it during the Persian captivity; then Herod added to it. Same thing: inside, the holy of holies, only the high priest went in there; the priests in the courtyard; and the homes and houses of Israel all around it. All of Israel did not live in Jerusalem, only some of Judah and Benjamin, and some Levi; the rest of Israel lived all around it. It’s going to be the same way in Isaiah 60: redone the same way, on a larger and more beautiful scale.

note.label: Ashke-Nazis - Blow Up Gaza & New Jerusalem

precepts.why:
“And the sons of strangers shall build up thy walls, and their kings shall minister unto thee”. “Therefore thy gates shall be open continually”: this is the reconstruction, the rebuilding of Jerusalem. “That men may bring unto thee the forces of the Gentiles”: the nations bring their wealth, “and that their kings may be brought”, in chains.

“The glory of Lebanon shall come unto thee, the fir tree, the pine tree, and the box together, to beautify the place of my sanctuary”: that sanctuary is going to be built just like in the days of old, but more glorious. “And I will make the place of my feet glorious.” So Jerusalem and the sanctuary have walls, and Israel dwells round about it in the land of unwalled villages, with the Lord a wall of fire round about.

note.label: Ashke-Nazis - Blow Up Gaza & New Jerusalem

precepts.why: “And said unto him, Run, speak to this young man, saying, Jerusalem shall be inhabited as towns without walls”. There you go: that is the land of unwalled villages Gog says he will go up to, Israel dwelling safely in the Kingdom, all of them dwelling without walls.

note.label: Ashke-Nazis - Blow Up Gaza & New Jerusalem

precepts.why:
Ezekiel’s fire and brimstone is the part in Revelation 20 where fire came down from heaven; it’s saying the same thing. “And they went up on the breadth of the earth, and compassed the camp of the saints about, and the beloved city: and fire came down from God out of heaven, and devoured them. And the devil that deceived them was cast into the lake of fire and brimstone, where the beast and the false prophet are”.

The great hailstones, fire and brimstone that God rains upon Gog and all his bands is the fire that came down from God out of heaven when Gog and Magog compassed the camp of the saints after the thousand years.

So these white people that came from Poland, Germany, Czechoslovakia, Uzbekistan, that’s the four corners of the earth? Whoever believes that is an idiot. Ask the white men in Israel: where is the tribe of Issachar, where’s Manasseh, where is Gad, where is Reuben, where’s Benjamin, where’s Ephraim and Zebulon, Naphtali? Where they at? No, hell no. So this chapter is not talking about this time period.

This has nothing to do with those people over there today. It is Revelation 20: after the thousand years, when Satan is loosed and the nations come up against the saints and the beloved city.
